description: Three LFOs whose rate, shape, amplitude, phase and duty cycle you set, with a trigger sent out where each pair of them crosses and a gate where all three come together

params.text: Sets the master frequency all three LFOs run from, 0 to 10; each LFO's rate knob multiplies this, so the three hold their ratios as this moves, and the freq input adds to it
Multiplies the master frequency to set this LFO's rate, 0 to 10: at 1 it runs at the master frequency and at 0.5 at half of it
Scales the voltage at this column's rate input before it is added to the rate knob, -1 to 1: it inverts below zero and passes nothing at the centre
Sets this LFO's amplitude, 0 to 1, reaching ±5V at its output with the knob fully clockwise
Scales the voltage at this column's amt input before it is added to the amount knob, -1 to 1: it inverts below zero and passes nothing at the centre
Sweeps this LFO's waveform through sine at 0, triangle at 1, sawtooth at 2 and rectangle at 3, blending between each neighbouring pair in between
Scales the voltage at this column's shape input before it is added to the shape knob, -3 to 3, so 10V at a setting of 3 moves the shape across its whole range
Offsets this LFO's phase, 0 to 1, which covers half a cycle rather than a whole one
Sets the duty cycle of the rectangle wave, 0 to 1 with 0.5 giving equal halves, and makes no difference to a shape setting below 2

inputs.text: Added straight to the freq knob, one step of that knob's 0 to 10 range per volt, with no attenuator of its own
Adds to this column's rate knob after the small knob beside it scales the voltage; 10V through an attenuverter at 1 adds one step to the rate knob
Adds to this column's shape knob after the small knob beside it scales the voltage; 10V through an attenuverter at 3 moves the shape across its whole range
Adds to this column's amount knob after the small knob beside it scales the voltage, and the total is held between 0 and 1
Restarts all three LFOs at the start of their cycle on each rising edge above 0V

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the first and second LFO outputs cross
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the first and third LFO outputs cross
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the second and third LFO outputs cross
Carries 10V for as long as the three LFO outputs are close together, meaning the three differences between them add up to under 0.1 in the LFOs' own units; this is a gate of no fixed length
The first LFO, ±5V with its amount knob fully clockwise
The second LFO, ±5V with its amount knob fully clockwise
The third LFO, ±5V with its amount knob fully clockwise
The first LFO minus the second, ±10V at full amplitude, passing through 0V at the instant the 1x2 trigger is sent
The first LFO minus the third, ±10V at full amplitude, passing through 0V at the instant the 1x3 trigger is sent
The second LFO minus the third, ±10V at full amplitude, passing through 0V at the instant the 2x3 trigger is sent
The first LFO minus the second minus the third, reaching ±15V at full amplitude; it is not the measure the 1x2x3 output tests, and it does not reach 0V when that output goes high

notes: the knobs and the ten CV inputs are read once every four samples, while the LFOs themselves run at every sample
an amount knob at zero holds that LFO flat at 0V, and crossings involving it stop while it is there
